overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's August 9 mask discussion was raised by the Town Manager and the Chair did not reasonably anticipate it 48 hours ahead, so it did not need to be on the notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed a topic at its August 9 meeting (mask requirements) that was not listed on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law, as the Board was not required to list a topic that the chair did not reasonably anticipate 48 hours in advance would be discussed at the meeting.
